# T-1: Add cleanup report display

<!-- Auto-generated by `sdd-forge spec render` from spec.json.tasks[]. Do not edit manually. -->

## Goal
Make finalize-cleanup emit a CLI-owned human-readable Report display while preserving JSON stdout and report-show equality.

## Acceptance Criteria
- stdout remains a single JSON envelope for finalize-cleanup success.
- a non-stdout human display block contains the exact report text when `data.report.text` exists.
- missing Report emits a visible `REPORT_MISSING` warning and no fabricated Report block.

## Implementation Notes
Prefer a dispatcher or cleanup-envelope helper that consumes the existing `data.report` field. Reuse `run-report-show.js` helpers and avoid a second report formatter.

## Test Strategy
Spec-local test spawns the CLI, parses stdout JSON, and compares the human display text with `flow report show` output from the same finalized spec.
